title: Jonas Johansson
subtitle: PROGRESS NOT PERFECTION
description: Jonas Johansson (1987–) is an anywhere-based artist, educator, and designer from Glommen, Halland, transforming light ✺ technology through ❋ play, community and (un)human intervention.
intro: Jonas Johansson (b. 1987) is a designer, artist, educator and speaker from Glommen, Halland. He studied graphic design in Norrköping, Reims, and Stockholm, and has worked at leading design studios in Tokyo, Montreal, London and Munich. He taught visual communication at [Beckmans](https://beckmans.se/) (2017–2025), and facilitated learning journeys at [Hyper Island](https://www.hyperisland.com/) (2014–2022). Jonas runs the artist residency [Visualia](https://visualia.se/), plans courses at [Svenska Tecknare](https://svenskatecknare.se/), and shares his studio with [SMASH](https://www.smash.studio/) and [Rose Hallgren](https://rosehallgren.com/). He is a part of [PLX](https://plxplxplx.com/), a [Svartljus](https://svartljus.se/) artist and is currently organising [Dome Dreaming](https://www.domedreaming.com) and [Ode Joy](https://ode.plxplxplx.com/).
